what: Archetype labels are planned as VOTER_N_TOOL values, but parse-rate retry still treats --voter-tool as the launcher tool
scenario_or_breakage: A cursor-validity or cursor-plan-fidelity voter that emits prose enters parse-rate-retry; launch_voter_retry rejects the label as an unknown tool, so the promised retry path silently stops working for the new normal panel
suggested_fix: Map cursor-* labels to the bare cursor launcher inside retry launch, or pass a separate launcher tool while preserving the archetype label for logs

what: Proposed --voter-labels can drift from EFFECTIVE_VOTER_FILES after parse-rate filtering
scenario_or_breakage: If voter 1 is removed by parse-rate diagnostics, votes from voters 2 and 3 compact left, but unfiltered labels can still write cursor-validity into v1_tool for cursor-plan-fidelity's vote, corrupting attribution TSV data
suggested_fix: Maintain EFFECTIVE_VOTER_LABELS in the same loop as EFFECTIVE_VOTER_FILES and write vN_tool only from the filtered effective label list

what: Expected voter count remains tied to Codex availability instead of the new Cursor panel topology
scenario_or_breakage: With Cursor available and Codex unavailable, one failed Cursor archetype yields 2 effective judges but no degraded warning; with Cursor unavailable and Codex available, the designed single-Claude fallback is reported as degraded
suggested_fix: Update expected_voters_for_round to return 3 when Cursor is available and 1 when Cursor is unavailable, ignoring Codex for code-review voter quorum warnings
